title: Worth doing soon: the upload Save's old-tree refusal rests on one guard; pin the store-level refusal on its own
evidence: Found by the H51 mutation check (PR 1720, 2026-11-14). An erase rule resting on one guard deserves a second pin: a store-level test that refuses an old-erase upload save with the session guard bypassed or stubbed, so each layer is pinned on its own.
